---
title: "Quant QC — Miceotopes"
author: ""
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
params:
  data_path: "data/file1.csv"
  linker_path: "data/file2.csv"
  isolation: "data/file3.csv"
  prot_vis_umap: NULL
  ChQ: 1
  plex_exp: 2
  t: 5

---


# Results {.tabset}

```{r Pre_proccess, include=FALSE}

# Read and format raw data, link MS runs to injection wells
QQC_obj_Exp <- DIANN_to_QQC(params$data_path, params$linker_path,
                             plex = params$plex_exp, carrier = FALSE)

# Build the Miceotopes-style peptide × cell matrix
# (uses the heavy/light channel structure rather than a carrier channel)
QQC_obj_Exp <- Miceotope_cellXpeptide(QQC_obj_Exp,
                                      chQVal = params$ChQ,
                                      t      = params$t)

# Map CellenONE metadata to MS runs
QQC_obj_Exp <- link_cellenONE_Raw(QQC_obj_Exp, params$isolation)

```


## LC/MS Performance Statistics

### IDs and intensities
```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=12}

QQC_obj_Exp <- Calculate_run_order_statistics(QQC_obj_Exp)

PlotIntensityDrift(QQC_obj_Exp)

```


### Retention time drift
```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}

PlotRTDrift(QQC_obj_Exp)

```


## Single Cell Statistics


### Negative control / single cell comparison

Here we plot the summed intensities across all peptides from a given single cell,
for all single cells and negative controls in the data.
```{r negative_ctrl, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.5, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

QQC_obj_Exp <- EvaluateNegativeControls(QQC_obj_Exp)

PlotNegCtrl(QQC_obj_Exp)

QQC_obj_Exp <- FilterBadCells(QQC_obj_Exp, min_intens = 7.0)

```


### Peptide trimming

Remove extra low-abundance peptides for proteins that already have sufficient coverage.
```{r trim, echo=FALSE, results='hold', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

cat("Abundance peptides before trim:", nrow(QQC_obj_Exp@matricies@peptide), "\n")
QQC_obj_Exp <- Trim_extra_peptides(QQC_obj_Exp)
cat("Abundance peptides after trim:", nrow(QQC_obj_Exp@matricies@peptide), "\n")

cat("Heavy/light peptides before trim:", nrow(QQC_obj_Exp@miceotopes@Raw_H), "\n")
QQC_obj_Exp <- Trim_extra_peptides_miceotopes(QQC_obj_Exp)
cat("Heavy/light peptides after trim:", nrow(QQC_obj_Exp@miceotopes@Raw_H), "\n")

```


### Cell size information

```{r cell_size, echo=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=4.5}

PlotCellSizeVsIntensity(QQC_obj_Exp, type = 'sample')

```


### Protein and peptide numbers per cell

All peptides are identified at 1% global FDR.

```{r collapse_and_count, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.5, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# Set ms_type to miceotopes for LC-corrected collapse
QQC_obj_Exp@ms_type <- 'miceotopes'
QQC_obj_Exp <- CollapseToProtein(QQC_obj_Exp, 1, LC_correct = TRUE)

# Switch back to DDA mode for downstream protein-level plots
QQC_obj_Exp@ms_type <- 'DDA'

PlotProtAndPep(QQC_obj_Exp)

```


### LC batch correction diagnostics

```{r lc_deviations, echo=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=4, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

PlotLC_Deviations(QQC_obj_Exp, global_trend = TRUE)

```

```{r lc_deviations_facets, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=12, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

PlotLC_Deviations(QQC_obj_Exp, global_trend = FALSE)

```


### Data completeness based on filtering

```{r completeness, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11.5, fig.height=4.5, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

PlotDataComplete(QQC_obj_Exp)

```


### Correlations between peptides mapping to the same protein

```{r pep_cor, echo=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=4.5}

QQC_obj_Exp <- SharedPeptideCor(QQC_obj_Exp)

PlotPepCor(QQC_obj_Exp)

```


### PCA and batch effect checks
```{r PCA, echo=FALSE, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=11, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

QQC_obj_Exp <- KNN_impute(QQC_obj_Exp)

# Correct for mTRAQ label bias only (run correction handled by LC_correct above)
QQC_obj_Exp <- BatchCorrect(QQC_obj_Exp, run = FALSE, labels = TRUE)

QQC_obj_Exp <- ComputePCA(QQC_obj_Exp)

PlotPCA(QQC_obj_Exp, by = "Condition")
PlotPCA(QQC_obj_Exp, by = "Label")
PlotPCA(QQC_obj_Exp, by = "Run order")
PlotPCA(QQC_obj_Exp, by = "Total protein")

```


### Additional dimensionality reduction and clustering

```{r UMAP, echo=FALSE, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=11, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

if (!is.null(params$prot_vis_umap)) {
  QQC_obj_Exp <- ComputeUMAP(QQC_obj_Exp)
  PlotUMAP(QQC_obj_Exp)
}

```


### Proteins of interest

```{r prot_viz, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.5}

if (!is.null(params$prot_vis_umap)) {
  fig1 <- ProteinClustConsistency(QQC_obj_Exp, prot = params$prot_vis_umap, type = 'line')
  fig1
} else {
  print("No protein specified — pass prot_vis_umap to visualize a protein of interest.")
}

```

The well position each set is transported into is overlaid in the middle of the cluster
of cells that compose a labelled set.

### Cell type positions across slide
```{r slide_celltype, echo=FALSE, fig.width=15, fig.height=10}

PlotSlideLayout_celltype(QQC_obj_Exp)

```

### Label position across slide
```{r slide_label, echo=FALSE, fig.width=13, fig.height=10}

PlotSlideLayout_label(QQC_obj_Exp)

```
